purpose: Sampling precision of unchanged hypothetical stationary-bootstrap fund mechanics; not forecast/model approval
quantile_ci: Exact binomial order-statistic intervals, Bonferroni across 45 quantities and all six planned looks; pooled independent seeds
probability_ci: Exact binomial intervals; loss, drawdown>90%, liquidation; Bonferroni across all planned quantities/looks
stop: All quantile intervals within .02 log units of estimate, both seed estimates within .02, latest doubling within .02, all probability half widths <=.025; otherwise retain failure at budget
zero: Retain genuine absorbing liquidation atom; distinguish floating underflow from liquidation; no positive NAV floor
legacy: Original 1024/2048/4096 test remains failed and unchanged. Larger registered checkpoints are new numerical evidence, not rewritten historical results.
prospective: Current snapshots archived before first future outcome; no backdating, no promotion on the consumed 26+25 forecasts
account_gate: Only run paired canonical account experiments after their underlying paired sample passes registered sampling precision. No replacement tax/balance formula.
